command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged inputs against their pinned sha256 =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 1b8cd336cc563d36595fc4148956fbafceb6441f6d8003ff2a78d7e31765d10c ensembl116_chr20.fa.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' 2ca5f41221505ddc5a87933b6240d6854423e8a7761aeec5d49e7b50b8380c94 ensembl116_chr20.gtf.gz
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

# STAR reads neither the fasta nor the GTF gzipped. gzip is a base-image utility,
# not a second scientific tool.
gzip -dc ensembl116_chr20.fa.gz  > chr20.fa
gzip -dc ensembl116_chr20.gtf.gz > chr20.gtf

echo "== STAR genomeGenerate: GRCh38 chr20 + chr20 annotation =="
# Two flags here are NOT defaults and must not be dropped:
#   --genomeSAindexNbases 11  STAR's default of 14 is sized for a whole genome. The
#                             documented rule is min(14, log2(genomeLength)/2 - 1);
#                             for chr20's 64,444,167 bases that is 11. Leaving it at
#                             14 wastes memory and time and STAR warns about it.
#   --sjdbOverhang 74         readLength - 1. These reads are 75 bp, uniformly.
STAR --runMode genomeGenerate --genomeDir idx --genomeFastaFiles chr20.fa \
     --sjdbGTFfile chr20.gtf --sjdbOverhang 74 --genomeSAindexNbases 11 \
     --runThreadN 8

# ---- smoke check on the index ----
# Exact where the value comes from the pinned inputs; banded where it comes from
# STAR's own layout choices.
CHRLEN=$(cut -f2 idx/chrNameLength.txt)
CHRNAME=$(cut -f1 idx/chrNameLength.txt)
NCHR=$(wc -l < idx/chrNameLength.txt | tr -d ' ')
KIB=$(du -sk idx | cut -f1)
SJDB=$(wc -l < idx/sjdbList.out.tab | tr -d ' ')

{
  echo "chromosomes    $NCHR     want exactly 1"
  echo "chr_name       $CHRNAME  want exactly 20   (Ensembl names it 20, not chr20)"
  echo "chr_length     $CHRLEN   want exactly 64444167"
  echo "index_kib      $KIB      want 300000..1200000  (observed 633068, ~619 MiB)"
  echo "sjdb_junctions $SJDB     want > 5000           (observed 17342)"
} > smoke-check-index.txt
cat smoke-check-index.txt

test "$NCHR"    -eq 1
test "$CHRNAME"  = "20"
test "$CHRLEN"  -eq 64444167
test "$KIB"     -ge 300000
test "$KIB"     -le 1200000
test "$SJDB"    -gt 5000
test -s idx/SA
test -s idx/SAindex
test -s idx/Genome
# genomeGenerate ignores --outFileNamePrefix and writes its log INTO the genome
# directory. That is where the completion line has to be read from.
grep -q 'finished successfully' idx/Log.out

# One tar object rather than an S3 prefix: see the salmon recipe and the README for
# why a directory output cannot work on spawn's container path.
tar -cf star-index.tar idx
rm -rf idx
test -s star-index.tar
echo "== index tar bytes: $(wc -c < star-index.tar) =="
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
